  var load = function (config) {

      var a = window.consentApi;

      // Only when blocker is active
      if (a) {
        // Iterate all modules and handle in a single `WebFont.load`
        Object.keys(modules).forEach(function (module) {

          }
        });
      }

  };

    };

		<div data-particle_enable="false" data-particle-mobile-disabled="false" class="elementor-element elementor-element-c3d28cb e-con-full e-flex qodef-elementor-content-no e-con e-child" data-id="c3d28cb" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-12a71e2 elementor-widget__width-inherit elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="12a71e2" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Kite station</h2>				</div>
				</div>
		<div data-particle_enable="false" data-particle-mobile-disabled="false" class="elementor-element elementor-element-d283eb4 e-con-full e-flex qodef-elementor-content-no e-con e-child" data-id="d283eb4" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a55546f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="a55546f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Our Kite Station with a large bar right on the beach is the absolute center of all the action.  It is a wonderful place to enjoy kitesurfing and to exchange ideas with like-minded people. Here you can not only enjoy the breathtaking view of the beach and the sea, but also take a refreshing break in the beach bar.</p><p>The kite station offers you the possibility to rent kites directly on site, so you don&#8217;t have to bring your own equipment. There is also a secure storage area where you can keep your kites safe when you are not on the water.</p><p>Sharing experiences with other kitesurfers is another great advantage of such a kite station. You can learn from the tips and tricks of others, make new friends and share your passion for kitesurfing with others. Overall, a kite station with a big beach bar, kite rental, storage of kites and exchange of experiences offers a perfect environment to enjoy kitesurfing and have unforgettable experiences.</p>								</div>
